component.name: Scratch Link
component.summary: Connect Scratch to Bluetooth LE and Classic peripherals

description.p: Scratch Link runs a small local WebSocket server that lets Scratch talk to Bluetooth LE and Bluetooth Classic (RFCOMM) devices such as micro:bit, LEGO BOOST, LEGO WeDo 2.0 and other serial or GATT peripherals. It talks to BlueZ over D-Bus, so no extra capabilities, certificates or hosts-file changes are required.
The service listens on the loopback interface by default and speaks the Scratch Link network protocol, which is also used by the official macOS and Windows applications.

screenshot.caption: Service status, adapter state and protocol log

description.p: First release: BLE discovery, GATT read/write, notifications, disconnect handling, Bluetooth Classic (RFCOMM) sessions, a GTK status window and a systemd user service.
